name: pm-panel
title: Shared PM composer and in-app panel
description: « Améliorer l'app »: one PmComposer (touch and desktop presets, FR/EN strings) with « Montrer », the point strip, numbered pins and timestamped chips; AppShell improve composes the in-flow sheet, strip and the full panel, and PmChat gives Studio the same conversation. Pins and chips come from the public feedback picker; the request card and « Mes demandes » render through StudioTaskBoardSeam (D-417).
